record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: For every triangle-free planar graph G, is χ⋆ℓ(G) ≤ 4, where χ⋆ℓ(G) is the least k such that every k-list-assignment of G admits k pairwise disjoint proper L-colorings?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.8 For a triangle-free planar graph G, is it true that χ⋆ ℓ(G)≤4?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. A list-assignment for $G$ is a function $L$ that assigns to each vertex $v\in V$ a finite set $L(v)$ of colors; if $|L(v)|=k$ for all $v$, then $L$ is called a $k$-list-assignment. A proper $L$-coloring of $G$ is a function $c$ with $c(v)\in L(v)$ for all $v$ and $c(u)\ne c(v)$ for every edge $uv\in E$. Two proper $L$-colorings $c_1,c_2$ are called disjoint if $c_1(v)\ne c_2(v)$ for every $v\in V$.

The list packing number $\chi^{\star}_\ell(G)$ is defined as the smallest positive integer $k$ such that, for every $k$-list-assignment $L$ of $G$, there exist $k$ pairwise disjoint proper $L$-colorings of $G$.

Call a planar graph $G$ triangle-free if it contains no cycle of length $3$. 

Question: Is it true that $\chi^{\star}_\ell(G)\le 4$ for every triangle-free planar graph $G$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on list packing of planar graphs (Cambie and collaborators, 2024) establishes upper bounds such as $\chi^{\star}_\ell(G)\le 5$ for planar graphs of girth at least 4 and $\chi^{\star}_\ell(G)\le 4$ for girth at least 5, but no proof of the bound $\chi^{\star}_\ell(G)\le 4$ for all triangle-free planar graphs has been reported. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: List Packing and Correspondence Packing of Planar Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: χ*ℓ(G) ≤ 5 for all planar graphs with girth at least 4, and χ*ℓ(G) ≤ 4 for all planar graphs with girth at least 5.
status_evidence.claim: Best known upper bound for triangle-free (girth ≥ 4) planar graphs is 5, not 4.

status_evidence.title: Disjoint list-colorings for planar graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Research on numbers of disjoint L-colorings for planar graphs with various girth conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Active research area; the bound 4 for triangle-free planar graphs is not established.
